lessons.keep: Use a small personal story to give a company mission a concrete origin.
lessons.avoid: Avoid a long manifesto that never gives the viewer one product experience to try.
lessons.open: Voice, music, exact text-to-speech sync, contrast at phone size and the future product remain unverified.
try: For a Tin founder film, pair a short first-campaign memory with two hand-drawn objects, then show the modern workflow that solves it.
Test progressive sentence highlighting on a short mission statement, checking full readability on a phone before adding decorative illustration.

comparison.story: Introduce childhood belief in magic. → Hold the wonder motif. → List later forms of technological wonder. → Build a shared history of invention. → Connect the magic theme with conversational AI. → Describe exploration before a change in direction. → Set up the author’s objection. → Inventory useful automation. → State the alternative aim. → Name the company and mission. → Return to the childhood premise. → Finish with playful identity.
